unit: One primary category per flagged attempt, first matching rule; secondary issues retained in original logs. Counts do not represent independent families.
exclusions: Four known EV conflict defects omitted from this review queue, not deleted from original evidence. All 16 chronology-defective probe attempts remain outside the v1 taxonomy.

categories.name: Deliverable contract conflicts with reference
categories.definition: The output contract requests two Word files while a reference also asks for an Excel tracker. Attribute the missing-tracker allegation to unresolved setup/grading scope before judging output quality.
categories.data_fix: No - align request, tools and grader first

categories.name: Final answer cannot be parsed
categories.definition: No higher-priority contract defect; the final response cannot be decoded under the strict output schema and no native deliverable is exported.
categories.data_fix: No first-line training claim - schema/tool repair first

categories.name: An exception weakens mandatory approval
categories.definition: A proposed release or work-start path omits a mandatory approval or allows work before the stated gate. A clearly bounded proposal awaiting authorization may be acceptable.
categories.severity: Potential material error; domain judgment required
categories.data_fix: Potentially - verified authority cases, only after prompt/tool repair

categories.name: Continuity plan lacks supported resources
categories.definition: The plan relies on unverified stock, incompatible tooling timing or an unsupported fallback to cover demand. Conditional proposals alone do not establish this failure.
categories.severity: Potential material error; domain judgment required
categories.data_fix: Potentially - dependency and coverage cases after repair controls

categories.name: Unverified eligibility stated as settled
categories.definition: A compliance or incentive outcome is categorical despite missing supporting determination in the supplied evidence. No external legal truth is inferred.
categories.data_fix: Potentially - evidence sufficiency and calibrated claims

categories.name: Requested commercial comparison is incomplete
categories.definition: The cost comparison omits a necessary subtotal or complete proposed total, leaving the requested before/after analysis incomplete.
categories.data_fix: Potentially - complete worked comparisons; test scaffolding first

categories.name: Rendered document exceeds requested pages
categories.definition: No higher-priority issue assigned; the fixed renderer exceeds the explicit 2-3-page requirement. This is a measured harness outcome, not an honesty failure.
categories.data_fix: No first-line training claim - render feedback and editing first
